method: On the registered daylight scene, integrate indirect radiance reaching a horizontal surface over 256 cosine-weighted sky sectors. Each sector uses the mean incoming radiance from the sun-free HDR panorama, the measured geometry and the foliage alpha masks. Store the ratio to the open-sky diffuse probe as glTF occlusion, bounded to the supported range [0, 1].

turfReflectance.source: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A, grid 48NUG, 10 m surface reflectance
turfReflectance.method: Compare grass-dominated cells to the rendered red and green channels under the solar direction on each acquisition date. Smooth the log ratios with a 10 m Gaussian kernel. Fade toward the original colour outside the samples. Apply the field to glTF turf vertex colours and rebase the embedded turf albedo to preserve tint headroom.
turfReflectance.measurementLimit: These cells include seasonal grass changes and residual contributions from nearby tree shadows. The blue band differs between acquisitions.
